message:
Capabilities:
[
 {
  "name": "Customer contracts",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Contracts",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Customer (text; required)",
     "Value a year (money; required)",
     "Start (date)",
     "Renews on (date)",
     "Notice (days)",
     "Notice date (computed; worked out: Renews on + 0 days)",
     "Owner (person)",
     "Budget owner (person)",
     "Billing email (email)",
     "Customer contact (text)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Draft (start)",
     "Legal review",
     "Signed",
     "Active",
     "Renewal due",
     "Renewed (last)",
     "Ended (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Contract managers: every row",
   "Contract owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "60 days before a contract's notice date, if it is still Active, move it to Renewal due and email its owner to ask them to act on the renewal.",
   "30 days before a contract's notice date, if it is still in Renewal due, email Wade and the owner to tell them nobody has acted.",
   "When a contract enters Renewal due, start a request in Renewal requests in Spend, named after the customer, with the customer, the yearly value, the renewal date and the contract's budget owner."
  ]
 },
 {
  "name": "Spend",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Expenses",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Expense ID (text; required)",
     "Date (date)",
     "Employee (person; required)",
     "Merchant (text)",
     "Description (text)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Category (choice; choices: Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training, Other)",
     "Diners (number)",
     "Payable (computed; worked out: 40 × 1 if Diners is empty, otherwise Diners if Category is Meals and Amount over 40 × 1 if Diners is empty, otherwise Diners, otherwise Amount)",
     "Receipt (file)",
     "Budget (link; links to Tools and budgets › Budgets)",
     "Project Code (text)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Submitted (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Paid (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Purchases",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Purchase (text; required)",
     "Supplier (text)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Requested by (person; required)",
     "Needed by (date)",
     "Approval (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Requested (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Ordered",
     "Received (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Renewal requests",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Renewal (text; required)",
     "Customer (text)",
     "Yearly value (money)",
     "Renews on (date)",
     "Budget owner (person)",
     "Decision (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Requested (start)",
     "Budgeted (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Spend admin: every row",
   "Spend finance: every row",
   "Everyone: own spend: their own rows",
   "Purchase approvers: every row",
   "Renewal budget owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "When an expense is submitted without a receipt, ask the person it is for to attach one in Receipt, and keep it waiting on them until it is attached.",
   "When an expense in Submitted has a receipt, whether added with it or attached later, email Lena to approve or reject it.",
   "When an expense in Submitted has a receipt, whether added with it or attached later, email Lena to approve or reject it.",
   "When an expense enters Approved, email Lena that it is ready to be marked paid with the next payroll.",
   "When a purchase over $2,000 is requested, ask Krishna to approve or decline it in Approval before it is ordered.",
   "When a purchase of $2,000 or less is requested, ask Lena to approve or decline it in Approval.",
   "When a purchase's Approval is set to Approved, move it to Approved.",
   "When a purchase's Approval is set to Declined, move it to Declined.",
   "When a renewal request starts, ask its budget owner to approve or decline it in Decision.",
   "When a renewal request's Decision is set to Approved, move it to Budgeted; when it is set to Declined, move it to Declined.",
   "When a renewal request's Decision is set to Approved, move it to Budgeted; when it is set to Declined, move it to Declined."
  ]
 }
]

Sentences:
1. 90 days before a contract's notice date, if it is still Active, move it to Renewal due and email its owner to ask them to act on the renewal.
